Third-party files used by the editor (editor/index.html).
They are copied unchanged from the CDNs named below, so the page needs no
outside requests (the app's Content-Security-Policy allows only same-origin scripts).

pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js
    pdf.js 3.11.174, https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/
    License: Apache License 2.0

pdf-lib.min.js
    pdf-lib 1.17.1, https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js
    License: MIT

fontawesome/
    Font Awesome Free 6.5.1, https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/
    License: icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT
